description: Every stream consumer the fleet holds, what it is behind on, and whether anything is still bound to it.
emptyBody: No streams or consumers were returned.
emptyDegraded: The JetStream API is unreachable, so this list is not the fleet.
aliasHint: A console-only label. Clear it to fall back to the consumer name.
durableHint: Creates a durable copy of this consumer. One way: JetStream cannot make a durable consumer ephemeral again.
durableFailed: The durable copy was not created.
confirmDurableBody: Creates a durable copy of {name} on {stream} that survives consumer restarts.
deleteHint: Nothing is bound to this consumer, so its pending messages will never be acked.
confirmDeleteBody: Deletes {consumer} from {stream}. The server refuses if a consumer is still bound.
capacityHint: In flight counts messages awaiting acknowledgement against the configured limit. A lane can process traffic while this stays at zero.
orderedHint: Grouped by stream. Unbound push consumers and backlog appear first.
